problems: No earlier report or dossier existed for this batch; all six dossiers were written in this run and validate with 0 errors (muzaffarids has one warning: counterpart 'atabegs-of-yazd' has no dossier yet).

Cliopatria's Wikipedia title 'Muzaffarids' is a disambiguation page (also 'Muzaffarid_dynasty'); the dossier uses the article 'Muzaffarids (Iran)' for identity.wikipedia and cites it; both disambiguation pages are listed in sources.

Hashemite Arab Federation: the Cliopatria row 1415-1439 (Wikipedia title 'Arab Iraq', which is a geographical term) is a lower-Iraq shape that belongs to jalayirid-sultanate (to 1432) and qara-qoyunlu; both shapes are marked wrong and the dossier describes the real federation of 14 Feb - 2 Aug 1958 as type umbrella. Cliopatria's Kingdom of Iraq (to 1957) and Iraqi Republic (from 1960) leave 1958-1959 without an Iraq shape.

aq-qoyunlu shares Wikidata Q555994 with lu: different states (Turkoman confederation 1378-1508 against the Zhou-era state of Lu), one id is wrong; Wikidata unreachable. The Aq Qoyunlu dossier keeps Q555994.

Cliopatria shape faults found: all five Sarbadar shapes are the lost 1340-43 maximum; Muzaffarid shapes lack Kerman and most of Fars; Qara Qoyunlu 1375/1385 shapes include Azerbaijan under the Jalayirids and the 1440/1463 shapes omit central Iran; Aq Qoyunlu 1440-1467 shapes carry Iraq, 1502-1506 keeps Iran after 1503; the Ramadanid shapes are one shape (0-2 cells apart).

Page budgets: qara-qoyunlu cites 6 pages (budget 5, the Aq Qoyunlu page shared), muzaffarids 6 (two are disambiguation pages), hashemite-arab-federation 3 (budget 2, the Jalayirid page shared). 20 distinct pages were opened for the batch (27 source entries).

Inter-dossier disagreements: ottoman-empire has gain ramadanid-emirate in 1515, the Ramadanid page says 1516; mamluk-sultanate has vassal_start ramadanid-emirate c. 1385 where the Ramadanid infobox says 1352 and aq-qoyunlu 1433-1472 that the Aq Qoyunlu page does not confirm; beylik-of-dulkadir has no 1465 loss of Harput to the Aq Qoyunlu.
Events that need a vassal side (the states as vassals) are in notes, not ledgers, because the schema writes vassal_start/_end from the suzerain's side.
